params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-capacity-cmd-1109'; if(Test-Path $dir){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dir; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'clone failed'}; $ac=Join-Path $dir 'tools\agent-control'; & cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d `"$ac`" && npm run check"; $check=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('CHECK_EXIT=' + $check); if($check -ne 0){exit $check}; & cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d `"$ac`" && npm test"; $tests=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('TEST_EXIT=' + $tests); if($tests -ne 0){exit $tests}; Write-Output 'AGENT_CONTROL_CAPACITY_FALLBACK_GREEN'
